    """
    from pymatgen.core import Structure

    from pymatgen.core.periodic_table import Specie

    properties = {

        "defect_complex_oxidation_state": None,
        "element_changes": None,
        "defect_structure_formula": None,

        "defect_complex_inequality": None
    }

        file_path = "tool_source_code/pymatgen-analysis-defects/tests/test_files/GaN.vasp"
        gan_struct = Structure.from_file(file_path)

        s = gan_struct.copy()
        o_site = PeriodicSite(Specie("O"), s[3].frac_coords, s.lattice)
        sub = Substitution(s, o_site)  # O substituted on N site
        vac = Vacancy(s, s.sites[0])  # Ga vacancy
        inter = Interstitial(s, PeriodicSite(Specie("H"), [0, 0, 0.75], s.lattice))  # H interstitial
        dc = DefectComplex([sub, vac])
        dc2 = DefectComplex([sub, vac, inter])

        # Calculate defect_complex_name
        properties["defect_complex_name"] = str(dc)

        # Calculate supercell_structure_formula
        supercell_structure = dc.generate_defect_structure()
        properties["supercell_structure_formula"] = supercell_structure.composition.reduced_formula

        # Calculate defect_complex_oxidation_state

            total_oxidation_state = sum([d.charge for d in dc.defects])
            properties["defect_complex_oxidation_state"] = (total_oxidation_state == dc.charge)
        except Exception:
            properties["defect_complex_oxidation_state"] = None

        # Calculate element_changes
        properties["element_changes"] = dc.get_element_changes()

        # Calculate defect_structure_formula

        # Calculate defect_complex_with_interstitial_name

        # Calculate defect_complex_equality

        # Calculate defect_complex_inequality

    except Exception as e:

        pass
